name: 1465 Pentair FRP Vessel
summary: The Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 1465 Top Open is a premium-quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pressure vessel designed for water treatment applications in residential, commercial, and industrial systems.
intro: The Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 1465 Top Open is a premium-quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pressure vessel designed for water treatment applications in residential, commercial, and industrial systems. With a 154-litre storage capacity and durable corrosion-resistant construction, it is ideal for use in water softeners, activated carbon filters, sand filters, multimedia filters, and other filtration systems. Engineered to withstand pressures up to 10 Bar (150 PSI), the vessel offers reliable long-term performance with minimal maintenance.
